title: Seedance 2.0で参照画像＋同一プロンプトを使って生成し、Gemini Omni Flashと出力クオリティを比較する
content:
Seedance 2.0で参照画像＋同一プロンプトを使って生成し、Gemini Omni Flashと出力クオリティを比較する  
参照画像は中世ヨーロッパの村の斜め上から見た俯瞰図（地図としても役立つ構図）を生成してSeedance 2.0の入力に使う  
参照画像生成プロンプト例：中世ヨーロッパの村の画像を作って。地図としても役立ちそうな、斜め上から見た俯瞰図。  
ルート（移動経路）指示はCanvaで参照画像に加工してからSeedance 2.0に渡す

en.content:
---
Generate using Seedance 2.0 with a reference image + the same prompt, and compare the output quality with Gemini Omni Flash.  
Create a reference image of a bird's-eye view of a medieval European village from an oblique angle (a composition useful as a map) to use as input for Seedance 2.0.  
Example prompt for generating a reference image: Create an image of a medieval European village. A bird's-eye view from an oblique angle that could also be useful as a map.  
Add route (movement path) instructions to the reference image using Canva before passing it to Seedance 2.0.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Here is the video created with Seedance 2.0 using the same reference image and prompt ↓
I feel the quality is above that of Seedance 2.0. https://t.co/3TbGlRFFZI

[Thread 2] Here is the prompt used for generating the reference image ↓
*Route instructions were processed with Canva
---------------------------
Create an image of a medieval European village.  
A bird's-eye view from an oblique angle that could also be useful as a map.
--------------------------- https://t.co/r67Z2RRCbH

[Thread 3] Detailed explanation on how to create such videos is in the note below.
You can easily create FPV drone videos, so please give it a try 😃

La imagen de referencia es una vista aérea desde un ángulo inclinado de un pueblo de la Europa medieval (una composición que también sirve como mapa) y se utiliza como entrada en Seedance 2.0

Las instrucciones de ruta (trayectoria de movimiento) se añaden a la imagen de referencia en Canva antes de pasarla a Seedance 2.0

참조 이미지는 중세 유럽 마을의 대각선 위에서 본 조감도(지도에도 유용한 구도)를 생성하여 Seedance 2.0의 입력에 사용합니다.

경로(이동 경로) 지시는 Canva에서 참조 이미지를 가공한 후 Seedance 2.0에 전달합니다.
